semantic.justification: Calc's common matrix lookup handles ordered and exact VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP over external cache matrices and inline arrays with the original type ordering, first and last match behavior, default sorted argument and scalar result rules. Worksheet ranges are handled by the separate direct query iterator. Matrix jump execution outside the represented scalar path remains pending. The original matrix search ignores wildcard and regular-expression expansion. Locale comparison uses the browser Intl collator with the configured Calc language and case-insensitive sensitivity. Evaluates logical arguments and local reference functions with original stack order and address conventions. Evaluates the source formula-cell predicate over scalar and matrix references.
